
CONTEXT
Load acceptance criteria (scenarios with their steps, tags and location) selected by a cucumber tag expression, in pages

WHEN TO USE
  Before working on a card, load its acceptance criteria with fspec context --tags @<workUnitId>, and read every page. Use it to find the scenarios of a tag, feature or phrase

WHEN NOT TO USE
  To change scenarios (use add-scenario, update-scenario or update-step) or to see coverage (use show-coverage)

PREREQUISITES
  • spec/features exists

USAGE
  fspec context [options]

OPTIONS
  --tags <expression>
    Cucumber tag expression with and, or, not and parentheses, e.g. '@auth and not @wip'. A scenario also has the tags of its Feature and Rule
  --text <text>
    Only scenarios whose name, step text, doc string or table cell contains the text (case-insensitive)
  --regex <pattern>
    Only scenarios whose name, step text, doc string or table cell matches the regular expression ((?i) ignores case)
  --feature <name>
    Only the feature file with this name (e.g. user-login or user-login.feature)
  --format <format>
    Output format: markdown, text or json
    Default: markdown
  --page <number>
    The page to print
    Default: 1
  --page-size <chars>
    The most characters of acceptance criteria on one page; a scenario is never split
    Default: 40000

EXAMPLES
  1. Load the acceptance criteria of card AUTH-001 before working on it
  $ fspec context --tags @AUTH-001

  2. Scenarios tagged @auth (on the scenario, its Rule or its Feature) that are not @wip
  $ fspec context --tags '@auth and not @wip'
  ## spec/features/user-login.feature

```gherkin
@auth
Feature: User login

  Background: User Story
    As a user
    I want to log in
    So that I see my board
```

### Login with valid credentials

Location: spec/features/user-login.feature:10
Inherited tags: @auth

```gherkin
@smoke
Scenario: Login with valid credentials
  Given I am on the login page
  When I enter valid credentials
  Then I see my board
```

---

page 1 of 1

  3. The second page of smoke or critical scenarios that are not deprecated
  $ fspec context --tags '(@smoke or @critical) and not @deprecated' --page 2

  4. Scenarios that mention a phrase, ignoring case
  $ fspec context --text 'invalid password'

  5. Scenarios of one feature that match a regular expression
  $ fspec context --regex 'log(in|out)' --feature user-login

  6. One JSON page (page, pages, nextCommand, features, items) of at most 20000 characters
  $ fspec context --tags @AUTH-001 --format json --page-size 20000

COMMON ERRORS
  ✗ invalid tag expression '@a not @b': ...
    Fix: Join tags with and, or and not, e.g. '@a and not @b', and quote the expression

  ✗ page 3 does not exist: there are 2 pages
    Fix: Use a page from 1 to the page count, or follow the 'Next page:' command

  ✗ feature 'x' does not exist in spec/features/
    Fix: Run fspec list-features for the feature names

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec show-feature
  fspec list-features
  fspec show-work-unit

NOTES
  • Each acceptance criterion is one scenario with all its steps, doc strings, data tables and Examples, its tags, its inherited Feature and Rule tags and its file:line
  • A page prints each feature's header (tags, name, description and Background) once, above that feature's first scenario on the page
  • Scenarios are ordered by feature file path, then line. A scenario larger than --page-size is alone on its page
  • Every page ends with 'page N of M' and, except the last, 'Next page:' with the exact command for the next page
  • All given filters must match; matching is exact (no semantic search)
